parent_objective: design no-PPO objective-only probe from M758 exact sanity result

public_gates: M760 designs a small objective-only probe
M760 requires exact before/after M758 metrics
M760 requires normal-history and first-action retention gates
M760 keeps sparse hard-negative handling explicit
PPO and checkpoint promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not allow hidden fault labels into actor observations
do not skip exact before/after objective metrics

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_actor_coupling: design no-PPO objective-only actor probe
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a small-step actor-coupling probe guarded by M758 exact metrics and retention gates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no actor update or policy improvement claim
stop_condition: stop if design cannot protect normal history
stop if design cannot report exact before/after M758 metrics
stop if design depends on complete hard negatives
stop if design admits PPO or promotion directly
fallback_plan: if normal retention cannot be gated, return to objective design
if hard negatives are too sparse, use positives-plus-normal probe only
if actor coupling risk is too high, design shadow-head probe first
if exact metrics are insufficient, extend M758 evaluator before actor update

hypothesis: A small no-PPO objective-only probe can be designed with exact metrics and retention gates before any actor update is attempted.
success_criteria: M760 defines exact M758 before/after gates
M760 defines normal-history and first-action retention gates
M760 defines alpha/interpolation and stop rules
M760 admits only an implementation probe and blocks PPO promotion
failure_criteria: design leaks hidden labels into actor inputs
decision_rule: M760 may only design a no-PPO objective-only probe. It must not implement actor updates PPO or promotion until a follow-up implementation manifest is registered.
